name: envelope/digest-canonical-object-basic
description: CanonicalObjectDigest per §11.8: SHA-256 over JCS of {$domain, protocol_major: 0, object_kind, schema_ref, projection} with the reserved $domain member injected per the family PROFILE type-tag rule. Construction mechanics only: kcp-decision-subject is the same example kind the key-order/unicode vectors use, its schema_ref names the existing #/$defs/args, and nothing binds this derivation to any real registry digest field — limits_digest and payload_digest remain shape-only recorded gaps (spec/schemas/README.md).
